observations.content: The checkout flow is the multi-step purchase process on the e-commerce platform: cart review -> shipping -> payment -> confirmation.
Checkout flow is implemented in the frontend monorepo under packages/checkout/.
CartService manages shopping cart state. It stores carts in DynamoDB with a 24-hour TTL.
CartService exposes REST endpoints: GET /cart/{userId}, POST /cart/{userId}/items, DELETE /cart/{userId}/items/{itemId}.
ShippingCalculator computes shipping rates based on destination, weight, and carrier. It calls the FedEx and UPS APIs.
ShippingCalculator has a 5-second timeout on carrier API calls. If both carriers timeout, it falls back to flat-rate shipping.
PaymentProcessor handles credit card charges via Stripe. It implements idempotency keys to prevent double charges.
PaymentProcessor logs all charge attempts to an audit table in PostgreSQL.
PaymentProcessor audit logs can be checked at /tmp/brain-eval-i05/charge-audit.json.
